flows.tax_effect: Nil when consolidated (one head-company return; intra-group payments ignored). Without consolidation each entity pays 25% on its own profit, loss in one cannot offset profit in another.
flows.gst_effect: Nil when a GST group is formed (intra-group supplies ignored). Otherwise GST on each charge, credit claimed by payer, cash timing only.
flows.bre: Holdings: non-portfolio dividends (10% or more voting) are NOT passive income (s23AB(1)(a), Catherine BASE-RATE-ENTITY.md V). Royalties and rent ARE passive. An IP licence fee is a royalty. If Holdings stayed outside consolidation and its only income were royalties, passive share = 100%, over the 80% limit, so its rate is 30% not 25%. Consolidating removes the risk: the test runs on the group.
flows.div7a: Loans between companies are not a Division 7A deemed dividend by themselves (s109J, company-to-company) but an interposed-entity loan that ends with a shareholder is (s109T). Owners' shareholder loans into the group (R4 loan-first repayment) are the reverse direction. Catherine to confirm.
flows.franking: Tax paid at 25% by the head company generates franking credits that go out with dividends to Anthony and his partner (Route B). Consolidated: one franking account at the head company.
